title: Pan runner playbook
description: A private runner policy that selects compatible work and declares its delivery mode.

capacity.description: Concurrent tasks this playbook may run. Set 0 to disable the playbook while keeping its configuration, for example while its workspace is in manual use.

delivery.description: Omit for pull-request delivery. Set direct only when this playbook is explicitly authorized to integrate and push to the configured default branch. Set report for read-only investigation delivered as an Issue comment for human review. Set playbook when this playbook's instructions define the entire workflow: the runner prepares no workspace and verifies no delivery, it only launches the agent in workingDirectory and monitors it.

workingDirectory.description: Absolute directory the agent is launched in. Required for playbook delivery and rejected for every other delivery mode, because the runner otherwise creates and owns the task worktree.

instructions: Create an isolated workspace before editing, and deliver using the metarepo tooling.
